import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Fill NaN in Sleep Disorder with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
order = ['None', 'Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea']
existing_orders = [o for o in order if o in df['Sleep Disorder Filled'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Sleep Disorder Filled', y='Sleep Duration', 
            palette='Set2', order=existing_orders, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Correlation between Stress Level and Physical Activity
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level', 
                hue='Quality of Sleep', palette='coolwarm', s=70, alpha=0.7, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Stress Level vs Physical Activity', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Quality', loc='upper right', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.viridis(range(0, 256, 256//len(occupation_sleep)))
bars = ax4.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for i, (idx, val) in enumerate(zip(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values)):
    ax4.text(val + 0.05, i, f'{val:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
